entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Binding element of the Ten Realms of Kaldheim and origin of all life there.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane of the Ten Realms bound by the World Tree.

entities.name: Ten Realms
entities.description: Realms of Kaldheim that shift around the World Tree.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: God of the World Tree who makes Cosmos Elixir from Tyrite.

entities.name: Tyrite
entities.description: Magical substance derived from the World Tree's sap.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: Users of Tyrite whose aging is slowed by the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Took a sample of tyrite on Kaldheim.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plans to link planes with the Realmbreaker.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the World Tree was burned.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: Contains a map of the Multiverse and every Omenpath.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who watched the World Tree birth new planes.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Collision of realms causing earthquakes and chaos.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm whose light shines atop the highest branches.

events.summary: Kaldheim's inhabitants burn down the World Tree to keep it from Phyrexia.
events.quote: the World Tree was burned down by Kaldheim's inhabitants to keep it out of Phyrexia's grasp

events.summary: The World Tree regrows, reconnecting some realms.
events.quote: It is now regrowing, enough to reconnect some of Kaldheim's realms.

events.summary: After peering into Loot's mind, Jace watches the World Tree birth new planes.
events.quote: Jace Beleren was able to watch the World Tree birth new planes

events.summary: Vorinclex takes a sample of tyrite.
events.quote: Vorinclex took a sample of tyrite during his exploits on Kaldheim

relations.quote: Esika is the god of the World Tree.
Esika makes a "Cosmos Elixir" from Tyrite
The World Tree of Kaldheim was the binding element of the Ten Realms
